summary: 7-phase (~6h) plan for a source-side tier-3 cross-repo fleet freshness view. Phase 1: git-tracked consumer registry at agent-system/extensions/core/context/reference/known-consumer-repos.json (path + note per consumer, plus discover_roots). Phase 2: new scripts/check-consumer-freshness.sh reusing deploy_freshness_status unmodified, reporting repo x extension x status x commits-behind for every registered consumer, plus manifest.json provides.scripts registration. Phase 3: --discover reconciliation naming unregistered on-disk consumers (never auto-edits the registry). Phase 4: guarded post-deploy stale-consumer report inside deploy-headless.sh's main(), verify result captured to a variable so the 0/1/2/3 exit contract is byte-for-byte preserved. Phase 5: DECISION on acceptance criterion (c) -- escalate, visibility-only, never blocking, counting consecutive command invocations (not days), threshold 5, state at specs/.freshness-warn-streak.json, with its three mandatory registration surfaces. Phase 6: fixture suite tests/test-consumer-freshness.sh. Phase 7: tier-3 documentation in regeneration-is-manual-only.md plus the utility-scripts inventory entry. No push into any consumer anywhere in the design.
next_action: Run /implement 93. Waves: [1,5] -> [2] -> [3,4] -> [6,7]. Phases 4 and 5 are the two full-verification-tier, highest-risk phases (deploy engine and the CHECKPOINT-1 preflight check respectively) and should not be batched with others.
